item.title: My first day in taiwan
item.description:
Arrival

My journey to Taipei started where I got 2 hours earlier to make sure that I really was able to catch my flight. And oh boy, that was kinda a mistake? As it turned out, the previous flight didn’t even started yet, because there was a thunderstorm in Frankfurt. After nearly two hours, the airplane finally arrived. A lot of other passengers already missed there flight. An announcement told me that we would land 8 PM in Frankfurt and after looking again at my boarding pass, it told that 8:05 PM boarding for my flight to Singapore would start. Thankfully, another announcement told me that there was a bus waiting for the Singapore flight that would transfer all passengers directly to the airplane.

item.title: CSD Riesa
item.description: Last saturday (22.08.2026) I was in Riesa together with a friend for the CSD (Christopher Street Day). Originally I planned to get there with two other friends, but one got sick and the other got a visit by his mother. The CSD is a european celebration and demonstration of LGBTQ+ rights. Riesa is a larger city between Leipzig and Dresden. This location is especially important for the CSB, because of the rise of the far right in East Germany and especially Saxony.

item.title: Dopsball Report: WiSe 2025/2026 Part 2
item.description:
February

The ways of elevators are inscrutable. Some people swear that certain elevators are faster than all the others. Others, on the other hand, actively avoid elevators because they always seem to take the slowest possible route. But everyone agrees that, for the most part, elevators are simply broken.

item.title: Dopsball Report: WiSe 2025/2026 Part 1
item.description: Dopsball is a reddit community that posts memes over the computer science department of my university. Over the years, especially in the last semester, some of the greates memes were created here. This is me commenting and reviewing every single meme that was posted there during the winter semester 2025/26. Because there were so many memes posted by fellow students, I decided to split this meme compilation into two parts. The first part that you are currently reading covers all posts from 01/10/2025 to 14/02/2026, were the second covers all from 15/02/2026 to 01/04/2026.

item.title: My take on some popular group games
item.description:
Every played any popular group game? Ever realized, how few decisions you can make that actually matter? Or that it

UNO

Does this game need an introduction? I think not. Personally, I don’t like Uno, because it rules are so simpel and the very few decisions you have often don’t effect if you win or not. But if you are looking for a really simple cardgame that you can take everywhere, that you can play with everyone no matter their age or willigness to concentrate on a game, than this the game for you. Additionally, UNO becomes really funny if you and your playgroup starts to create your own rules. Alternativly, you can also use a modified version like “Uno No Mercy”.

item.title: Brownie Cookies 🍪
item.description:
I’m leaving this recipe for everyone who loves cookies as much as I do. If you’re reading this, I hope you try it and enjoy it!

All credits for the recipe goes to https://www.tasteofhome.com/recipes/jumbo-brownie-cookies/! Check out their amazing cookies!

Ingredients

  • 2-2/3 cups 60% cacao bittersweet chocolate baking chips
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cubed
  • 4 large eggs, room temperature
  • 1-1/2 cups sugar
  • 4 teaspoons vanilla extract
  • 2 teaspoons instant espresso powder, optional
  • 2/3 cup all-purpose flour
  • 1/2 teaspoon baking powder
  • 1/4 teaspoon salt
  • 1 package (11-1/2 ounces) semisweet chocolate chunks

Directions

  1. Preheat oven to 350°. In a large saucepan, melt chocolate chips and butter over low heat, stirring until smooth. Remove from heat; cool until mixture is warm.
  2. In a small bowl, whisk the eggs, sugar, vanilla and, if desired, espresso powder until blended. Whisk into chocolate mixture. In another bowl, mix the flour, baking powder and salt; add to chocolate mixture, mixing well. Fold in chocolate chunks; let stand until mixture thickens slightly, about 10 minutes.
  3. Drop by 1/4 cupfuls 3 in. apart onto parchment-lined baking sheets. Bake until set, 12-14 minutes. Cool on pans 1-2 minutes. Remove to wire racks to cool.

item.title: How I created my own page
item.description:
Some days ago, I was constantly asked if I had any website. Every time I replied with no, it filled me with sadness. Therefore I created this website to stop the haters! But how should I desing my very own page? Which content should I put into it? What do I want, or sometimes more important, don’t want?

My Plan
